sloka: तदिदं मानुषं मन्ये प्राप्तं निस्संशयं भयम्।जीवितान्तकरं घोरं रक्षसां रावणस्य च ।। ६.९५.३० ।।
transliteration: tadidaṁ mānuṣaṁ manye prāptaṁ nissaṁśayaṁ bhayam।jīvitāntakaraṁ ghoraṁ rakṣasāṁ rāvaṇasya ca ।। 6.95.30 ।।

translations.english: "Brahma has lovingly provided protection to Ravana from Devas, Danavas and Rakshasas. He did not seek protection from humans."
